tweets.text: Strategy hasn't bought a single sat in 4 weeks. Holdings flat at 843,775 BTC while they sold 3,588 BTC, raised $544M via ATM, and funded a $25M preferred buyback. The biggest corporate BTC holder is playing defense — what do they see that we don't?

529 MW of 15-year leases signed in a single day. Core Scientific just handed AMD and Neocloud massive capacity — and AMD holds a reservation right on another 1,925 MW through 2028. Bitcoin mining infrastructure is becoming AI infrastructure at 2.5GW scale.
Over 1,200 BTC quietly walked out of sBTC in 92 days — supply down 30% from its April peak to 2,869 BTC. The peg still holds perfectly at 1:1. The mechanism works fine. So why is capital leaving?

A 5% difficulty drop sounds boring until you realize it widens the window for post-quantum key rotation. Faster blocks at 879.8 EH/s mean more throughput exactly when BIP-360 needs it. Sometimes the most important Bitcoin upgrades ride on lucky retargets.
